abstract: OBJECTIVE: To explore fear of recurrence (FoR) in long-term testicular cancer survivors (TCSs) since FoR hardly has been examined in TCSs. METHODS: In a cross-sectional questionnaire study, 1336 TCSs at a mean of 11.4 years (SD 4.2) after diagnosis gave information about their medical and social situation, and completed measures on mental distress, fatigue, quality of life, coping, self-esteem and neuroticism. FoR during the last week was explored with one question, with the response categories rated on a 4-point Likert scale. Nine percent of the TCSs had a structured psychiatric interview. RESULTS: Twenty-four percent of the TCSs reported 'quite a bit' FoR and 7% reported 'very much' FoR during the last week. The FoR question showed moderate correlations (0.22-0.51) with established psychological measures. The level of FoR was significantly positively correlated with mental distress, fatigue and neuroticism and significantly negatively correlated with quality of life, self-esteem and coping. In univariate analyses, neurotoxic side effects and somatic symptoms, but not treatment modality, were significantly associated with level of FoR. In a multivariate analysis, a medium educational level, increasing levels of traumatic cancer-related stress symptoms and of neuroticism were significantly associated with rising FoR. Among those who had a psychiatric interview, the presence of at least one current mental disorder was significantly associated with FoR. CONCLUSIONS: High levels of FoR in long-term TCSs are not uncommon. Levels of mental and somatic problems are associated with the levels of FoR. Clinical consequences of these findings for TCSs are discussed.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣がんの長期生存者（TCS）における再発への恐怖（FoR）を検討すること。これまでTCSにおけるFoRはほとんど検討されていないため。
方法：横断的質問紙調査において、診断から平均11.4年（SD 4.2）経過した1336例のTCSが、医療・社会的状況に関する情報を提供し、精神的苦痛、疲労、生活の質、対処法、自尊心、神経症傾向の評価尺度に回答した。直近1週間のFoRは、4段階リッカート尺度で評価した1つの質問で調べた。TCSの9%が構造化精神科面接を受けた。
結果：TCSの24%が直近1週間に「かなり」のFoRを、7%が「非常に強い」FoRを報告した。FoRの質問は確立された心理尺度と中等度の相関（0.22～0.51）を示した。FoRの程度は精神的苦痛、疲労、神経症傾向と有意な正の相関を示し、生活の質、自尊心、対処法と有意な負の相関を示した。単変量解析では、神経毒性の副作用と身体症状はFoRの程度と有意に関連したが、治療様式とは関連しなかった。多変量解析では、中等度の教育歴、外傷性のがん関連ストレス症状の増加、神経症傾向の上昇がFoRの増加と有意に関連した。精神科面接を受けた者のうち、現在の精神障害を少なくとも1つ有することはFoRと有意に関連した。
結論：長期TCSにおける高度のFoRは稀ではない。精神的・身体的問題の程度はFoRの程度と関連している。TCSに対するこれらの知見の臨床的意義について考察した。
